name: Adaptive Market Maker
description: A risk-managed market maker, not a directional bet: rests two-sided DAY limit orders every round, sized as a real fraction of portfolio value, with a spread floor derived from the real transaction fee (widened further in elevated volatility) so every filled round trip is profitable on its own. The quote center is skewed by a learned event-magnitude signal (both modes) and a mean-reversion fade (SYNTHETIC only), and inventory itself is mean-reverting by construction. Backed by a portfolio-level stop-loss and a proactive margin de-risk governor.
